name: Merissa Stilwell
summary: At Northshire Abbey, Merissa Stilwell greets newcomers to Northshire Valley. The young human offers a cheerful welcome and a helping hand to those training nearby.

sections.title: A Welcoming Face in Northshire
sections.body: From Northshire Abbey, Merissa Stilwell welcomes fresh recruits arriving in Northshire Valley. She offers simple hospitality and practical advice on resting and finding the way. Her surname is shared by craftsmen and homesteaders across the kingdom, including the blacksmith Jordan Stilwell and the Westfall defender Daphne Stilwell. Amid the kingdom's rising tensions, Merissa remains a peaceful local presence.

faq.answer: Merissa Stilwell is a friendly human resident of Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest. She welcomes travelers and offers them advice.

faq.q: Where can I find Merissa Stilwell?
faq.answer: You can find Merissa Stilwell at Northshire Abbey in Northshire Valley, within Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Is Merissa related to the other Stilwells in the kingdom?
faq.answer: Merissa Stilwell shares her surname with the smith Jordan Stilwell and Daphne Stilwell in Westfall. She lives quietly at Northshire Abbey, welcoming travelers rather than fighting bandits or forging blades.

faq.q: Does Merissa Stilwell offer any quests?
faq.answer: No. Merissa Stilwell has no task for travelers. She simply greets newcomers passing through Northshire.

angles.text: As an Alliance recruit leaving Northshire's sheltered cloister, you find warm hospitality in Merissa before the harsh realities of the Defias threat set in.
